_comment: S-4 — crisis page resource list (HREC approval §8.1 order). Numbers below are PLACEHOLDERS carried over from the pre-baseline page / public listings and have NOT been verified for the Phase A baseline: the PI must confirm each against the organisation's own website, then set verifiedDate (YYYY-MM-DD). Until verifiedDate is set the crisis page footer reads 資料核對日期：待核對. Item flagged acuteTemplateReference is the hotline named in the three acute templates and must stay at position 1 or 2.
